reasons: Claimed status is compliant and, consistent with that, no redline or comment was proposed — the rendered text is identical to the original paragraphs.

The cited paragraphs support compliance: § 2's grant is expressly 'non-transferable and non-exclusive' and the § 3 covenants (e.g. 'not use the Work except as authorized herein') are ordinary licence-scope limits, not a requirements-purchase or 'shall not procure from any third party' obligation on Sparkling.

No exclusivity, sole-supplier or minimum-requirements covenant binding the Customer appears in the cited text, so the clause meets the preferred position (no exclusivity on Customer); the deterministic check confirms no residual sole-supplier obligation.

Rationale is accurate and appropriately notes that other uses of 'exclusive' (exclusive remedy, non-exclusive jurisdiction, escrow licence) do not restrict our freedom to source elsewhere; retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
